public_gates: implement two P0-compatible natural belief decision-window configs
run reset sampling stress on seed blocks 11800 11900 12000
run small behavior smokes for M399 and baselines if sampling passes
do not mine proof rows or train
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add privileged actor inputs
do not run proof mining before sampling validation
do not tune from private holdout
hypothesis: A short-reveal and a warm-up capability-evidence config can create robust natural decision-window tasks where command-response history may matter before current-response correction dominates.
success_criteria: each config has 384/384 reset successes across seed blocks 11800 11900 12000 or failures are documented
at least one config has >=2 labels and single-label share <=0.80
behavior smokes complete for at least one sampling-valid config
failure_criteria: label distribution collapses to one label
behavior smokes are saturated or fail to run
training or proof mining is performed

commands.name: config_implementation
commands.command: Add m494 short-reveal and warm-up capability-evidence zero-relvel configs.

commands.name: sampling_validation
commands.command: Run 128 reset attempts for seed blocks 11800 11900 12000 on each config.

commands.name: behavior_smokes
commands.command: Run small M399/reset/zero-current/heuristic/random smokes on sampling-valid configs.

decision_rule: M494 should admit natural matched-current mining only if at least one config is sampling-robust and non-saturated; otherwise repair configs before mining.
